title: Mushroom Burger
subtitle: with a deep-fried portobello patty
description: A vegetarian burger with a deep-fried portobello mushroom seasoned with Asian sauce, layered with lettuce, onion, pickle and tomato in a bun.

steps.text: Cut the bun in half. Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on the bottom half and place it on a griddle heated to 100°C for about 20 seconds.
Spread tomato sauce on the other half and layer on thinly sliced lettuce (spread evenly, not too much), red onion and pickle slices, then a slice of tomato to hold the other vegetables in place.

Deep-fry the mushrooms in very hot oil for 2 minutes until soft. Remove and place on the griddle, cap side down, for 1 minute. Meanwhile, pierce the underside a little with a knife and season with the Asian sauce. Flip, cook for another 30 seconds and transfer to the bun. Serve hot.
